description: The Cedar Creek Trail is 2.4 Km long one way, and leads to an old abandoned mine site. This historic trail ascends moderately for the first 500 meters up the trail, continues to climb slowly, and meanders along Cedar Creek. On route there are many remains of old pieces of mining equipment scattered along the trail. Near the top, the trail passes by the Ainsworth cemetery with some of the headstones dating back to the late 1800�s. Please be respectful of the burial grounds.
directions: From Nelson drive 49 KM North along Highway 3A/31 to Ainsworth Hot Springs. From here, travel North (towards Kaslo) along Highway 31 for another 1.3 KM to reach a small bridge crossing over Cedar Creek. There is a small parking lot just South of the bridge. The trailhead can be found right off the Highway on the North side of the bridge.
title: Cedar Creek Trail
